title: Te Reo i Whakakahore i te Ngakau Pōuri
intro: Eke atu ki tētahi whare e whai ana te mate i te mate, engari kotahi te reo marino e whakakahore ana i te ngakaukore. Kotahi te karanga i roto i te Qur'an ka huri te manawanui hei pūwāhi hurihanga; ka taea e koe te whai i ngā tohu ki te tangata kei muri i taua reo?
clues: Ko ahau te reo o te manawanui i roto i tētahi whare i whakamatautauria ai ngā manaakitanga e te aituā.
I noho ahau i roto i tētahi whare kua ururuatia e te ngaronga o te taonga me ngā tamariki.
I mōhio ahau kua pā mai te mate ki taua hoa, nō te mea kua pāngia tōna tinana e te mate.
I te kaha o te pōuri, ka karanga ahau me te whakamahara ki a Allah.
Kotahi taku kīanga: Ko Allah te Pono, nō reira kia manawanui.
I karanga ahau i a Ayyub mā te ingoa; ā, muri iho, ka tangohia e Allah te mamae, ā, ka whakahokia mai te whānau.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ayyub
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Noa
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ihāperahama
Te Wahine a te Poropiti a Hākupa
Te tamahine a Parao
identity.answer: Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ayyub

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te noho tahi me Ayyub i roto i te mate me te mate, kātahi ka karanga kia manawanui
He whakatūpato i tētahi karere tika kia whakarērea tētahi hapori pirau
Te inoi mō te whānautanga o tētahi whakapapa ā muri ake nei
Te whakamārama i ngā moemoeā i roto i te whare herehere kingi
Te kimi i tētahi tamaiti whakawhirinaki i te taha o te awa
trial.answer: Te noho tahi me Ayyub i roto i te mate me te mate, kātahi ka karanga kia manawanui

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ko te whakapuakitanga ko Allah te Pono, ā, e hiahiatia ana te manawanui
He nikau i te taha o te puna
He karanga kia hanga he waka kia matara atu i ngā ngaru
He moemoeā mō ngā whetu tekau mā tahi me te rā e ara ake ana
He kete e amohia ana i te awa o te Naera
location.answer: Ko te whakapuakitanga ko Allah te Pono, ā, e hiahiatia ana te manawanui

outcome.label: Hua
options: I tangohia te mamae o Ayyub, ā, i whakahokia mai tōna whānau
I muri i te inoi pakoko, i tukuna mai he tamaiti kua roa e tatarihia ana
I whakamāramahia e te rangatira taitamariki ngā tau e whitu o te hua me te koretake
I whakaorangia tētahi tamaiti i whakawhirinakihia mai i te wai e rere ana
I mua i te waipuke whakangaro i puta he whakatūpato
outcome.answer: I tangohia te mamae o Ayyub, ā, i whakahokia mai tōna whānau

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
